before.title: Global free-flowing rivers — connectivity assessment
before.description: The complete river-reach network from Mapping the world’s free-flowing rivers, prepared as spatially ordered GeoParquet with its connectivity attributes. A separately versioned PMTiles layer provides zoom-dependent map display and source-ID attribute lookup.

requested.description: The complete river-reach network from Mapping the world’s free-flowing rivers, preserved in GeoParquet with all producer fields and source geometry. A separately versioned PMTiles layer provides zoom-dependent map display and source-ID attribute lookup.
